Name: S01
Title: THE UNMADE
Subtitle: Some worlds are broken. This one remembers being whole.
Narration: Before maps had borders, a silence began swallowing the questions no one dared answer.

Name: S02
Title: A PERSON WITHOUT A PAST
Subtitle: Create an identity. Discover an impossible origin.
Narration: You choose who to become. The world remembers your actions, even when it cannot agree on your beginning.
DirectorNote: source character origin; no false game footage

Name: S03
Title: THE FIRST MISSING NOTE
Subtitle: The Threefold Reach · Bellwold · Paperhaven
Narration: A bell rings from a road no one has walked. One neighbor remembers it. Another has proof it never existed.

Name: S04
Title: WHERE THE WATER WENT
Subtitle: Saltwake · The Widowed Rain
Narration: Ships rest above a vanished sea. Read its wet ledger, hear its people, and decide what its absence is worth.

Name: S05
Title: A FLAME NOBODY OWNS
Subtitle: Cinderhold · The Hearth Beneath
Narration: A city borrows fire from a sun that never rose. Warm a neighbor, or uncover whose life feeds the hearth.

Name: S06
Title: THE NINE REALMS
Subtitle: The atlas is a mystery, not a checklist.
Narration: Every destination has a language, a social code, a hazard and a story. The route you choose changes what you understand.
DirectorNote: show earned crossings not nine mandatory regions

Name: S07
Title: THE DEBT OF TOMORROW
Subtitle: Drevlach · The Sea of Written Debts
Narration: In Drevlach, tomorrow can be sold. The signature on the contract belongs to someone not yet born.

Name: S08
Title: THE WEIGHT OF A VOICE
Subtitle: Orravane · The Upside-Down Choir
Narration: Entire streets hang beneath the sky. A missing voice is holding them up. Restore it carelessly, and homes may fall.

Name: S09
Title: THE BONES OF YESTERDAY
Subtitle: Vathless · The Yesterday Quarry
Narration: People were cut from history and shaped into stone. Their descendants still live in the houses their names support.

Name: S10
Title: A RIGHT TO EXIST
Subtitle: Eillun · The Hundred Unlived
Narration: A city shelters people the world insists were never born. Recognition can protect them, or expose them to danger.

Name: S11
Title: THE CROWN LEFT EMPTY
Subtitle: Tharniv · The Untitled Orchard
Narration: An unwritten law survives every ruler who refused it. Follow living roots, and ask who gave the court its power.

Name: S12
Title: BEFORE THERE WAS A PLACE
Subtitle: Auvren · The First Absence
Narration: Two true beginnings meet at a threshold. The oldest witness remembers you before you arrive.

Name: S13
Title: POWER WITH A PRICE
Subtitle: Ten abilities · readable trade-offs · lasting consequences
Narration: Suspend a law. Borrow a life. Bind a promise. No power erases a person’s consent, and every choice leaves a mark.
DirectorNote: Tenfold powers are limited and earned

Name: S14
Title: A WORLD THAT ANSWERS BACK
Subtitle: Investigate · fight · spare · return · discover
Narration: Guardians can be defeated or understood. Neighbors remember. Bridges remain. Returning years later reveals the weight of your decisions.
DirectorNote: NPC memory, combat, rematch and altered space

Name: S15
Title: THE LAST QUESTION
Subtitle: Nhal-Vey · The Answer That Ate Its Question
Narration: At the edge of Auvren, you face the thing holding these contradictions together. But what if victory changes the world?

Name: S16
Title: THE WORLD IS NOT FINISHED
Subtitle: The Unmade · A living consequence-driven adventure
Narration: Every realm changes you. Every decision changes a place. And the world you save may not be the world you remember.
